visit.trail_note: Reached on foot by the forest's trails from the campground area; not open for climbing.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1937, and a January 1937 newspaper item describes the tower as still to be erected. The park history and a 2026 trail write-up give 1935, probably following the park's page. The timeline uses 1937.

The park's wording says the tower remains open but not operational. The register describes a fence and removed stairs, and the trail write-up says it is not open for climbing. Recorded as restricted: walking to it is possible, climbing is not.

notes_for_editor: Built year conflicts: register 1937 vs park page and trail blog 1935; the January 1937 item supports 1937 (described as yet to be erected). Access conflicts: park wording 'open' vs register fence and trail blog 'not open for climbing'; recorded as restricted. No fire or staffing history found. easternuslookouts tick-ridge1.html covers a different Tick Ridge in Carter County and was excluded. A Facebook group post and a Historic Wayne County post could not be read in full, so they are not used. The record's 80-foot height and 1,367 ft elevation fit the sources; no record corrections proposed.
